name: InitMemoryCardSystem
evidence: calls func_002093F0, InitBackgroundJob(&g_backgroundJob) and InitMemoryCard(&g_memoryCard, 0, 0); listed in the game's init function table D_002647C0

name: InitBackgroundJob
evidence: creates a semaphore into the record's first word, sets the thread word to -1 (no thread) and the result word to 0x22

name: RunBackgroundJob
evidence: the thread's entry: calls the job with the argument, keeps the return value in the result word, sets the thread word to -1 and clears the job and argument

name: StartBackgroundJob
evidence: after func_0018B720, stores the job function and its argument in the record, sets the result to 0x20, creates a thread whose entry is func_0018B600 and starts it with the record as argument

name: WaitForBackgroundJob
evidence: when a job is running calls func_001F6A50 on its thread, then takes and releases the job's lock (func_001F6B60, func_001F6B40), as RunBackgroundJob holds it while the job runs; StartBackgroundJob calls it first

name: IsBackgroundJobRunning
evidence: returns whether the record's thread word is not -1 (func_0018BDC8 and func_001943E8 wait for it to be 0 before starting or reading a job)

name: ConvertMemoryCardDirEntry
evidence: clears a 0x5C-byte record, copies the 32-byte name at +0x20, the size at +0x10 and maps attribute bits of the source to a flag word at +0x48 plus created/modified time bytes

name: ClassifyMemoryCardCallResult
evidence: maps a card call's return value to 29 (zero), 30 (positive) or 31 (negative)

name: ClassifyMemoryCardSyncResult
evidence: maps a card sync return value 0, 1, -1 to 32, 33, 34 and anything else to 31

name: MapMemoryCardErrorCode
evidence: big switch from an operation code (1..21) and a card result value to the game's error code (0, 1, 9..26, 31, 35)

name: SyncMemoryCardResult
evidence: calls func_00209B80 for two ints, classifies the first with func_0018B930, stores the second through a2 and for 33 turns it into a game code with func_0018B988

name: FinishMemoryCardCall
evidence: every card operation passes its return value and operation code here: classifies the value with func_0018B910 and, when it is 29, completes it with func_0018BC90

name: InitMemoryCard
evidence: clears the 0x4F50 bytes, sets the state to -1 and the target to 0, resets the display mode with func_0018C178 and stores its two arguments as port and slot

name: UpdateMemoryCard
evidence: when no job runs, starts func_0018D0A0 as a job once nextPollTime is reached if state equals targetState, otherwise calls func_0018C028; then picks a prompt from the state once displayMode is 1

name: CompareMemoryCardEntryTimes
evidence: subtracts the time fields (+0x54, +0x52, +0x53, +0x56, +0x57, +0x58) of two ConvertMemoryCardDirEntry records in order and returns the first difference; func_0018C028 uses it to pick the newest slot

name: SetMemoryCardState
evidence: stores a new state with the clock time, starting func_0018D0A0 or func_0018C420 as the job that state needs

name: SetMemoryCardDisplayMode
evidence: stores a new display mode and the clock time when it differs from the current one, and clears the selected image when the mode is 2

name: RunMemoryCardFormatJob
evidence: the background job pause page 4's first item starts (ActivatePauseMenuSelection): runs FormatMemoryCard and sets targetState 2 (back to page 4) on failure or 3 (page 7, which creates the save files) on success

name: GetKeyedDataSize
evidence: builds a key pair from two xored word pairs, returns func_001407A0 of it (0 when the key is empty); func_0018C250 turns the result of D_00248470 into a block count

name: CreateMemoryCardSaveFiles
evidence: checks the free blocks against the needed count, makes the save directory, writes the icon and header files and the three "saveN" slot files, then raises the target state to 5

name: LoadMemoryCardSaveSlots
evidence: lists the save directory and reads the three slots "saveN" with func_0018CDD8, then raises the target state to 5

name: ApplyMemoryCardImage
evidence: copies the card object's image into the live game state D_002623C0 and refreshes it with func_001A7E90; returns 0x2C when there is no image

name: SaveGameToMemoryCardSlot
evidence: copies the live game state into the slot record, derives its number from its address within the card object (stride 0x1A5C) and writes "/dir/saveN" with func_0018CFC0

name: WriteSelectedMemoryCardSlot
evidence: same file name as func_0018C638, derived from the slot pointer at i4F4C, written with func_0018D028

name: StartMemoryCardSave
evidence: when the save flag allows, starts the background job SaveGameToMemoryCardSlot, otherwise shows the pause-menu page; called when a level is marked done

name: ListMemoryCardDirectory
evidence: rejects counts above 0x12 and names longer than 0x40, calls the card directory read (operation 0xD) into a 0x480-byte buffer and converts every entry (0x40 each) into a 0x5C record with func_0018B780

name: CheckMemoryCardFileExists
evidence: lists the directory entries matching a name with func_0018C888 (at most 1) and returns 0 when exactly one is found, else 14

name: WriteMemoryCardSaveHeader
evidence: builds a 0x3C4-byte settings block of colours and floats, with the icon name, and writes it as "dir/icon.sys" with func_0018D368

name: WriteMemoryCardIcon
evidence: writes the keyed data D_00248470 under the name "sly.ico" in the given directory with func_0018CC20

name: WriteMemoryCardKeyedFile
evidence: opens "dir/name" for creation, opens the stream described by a key and copies it to the file in 0x1000-byte pieces; code 0x27 without a key

name: ReadMemoryCardSlotFile
evidence: reads a save file, requires the directory entry attributes, size 0x1A00, type 18, matching size and checksum (func_00160650), and copies the record out; codes 20, 28, 27, 8 for the failures

name: WriteMemoryCardSlotFile
evidence: sets the slot record's type to 18 and size to 0x1A00, stores the checksum of func_00160650 and writes 0x1A00 bytes to the file with func_0018D368

name: WriteMemoryCardSlot
evidence: initialises the slot record with func_001605E8, writes it with func_0018CFC0 and then checks the file with func_0018C9C0

name: PollMemoryCard
evidence: queries the card at port and slot with func_00209CB8 into the card words and free blocks, sets targetState from the result and nextPollTime to the clock plus 0.3

name: GetMemoryCardFreeBytes
evidence: calls the card info function (operation 1), maps result codes 9 and 10 to 0 and 12 and stores the free block count << 10

name: FormatMemoryCard
evidence: sends the card server operation 0x10 (func_00209FA8) with only the card's port and slot (+4, +8) and passes the result to FinishMemoryCardCall; RunMemoryCardFormatJob runs it before the save files are created

name: CreateMemoryCardDirectory
evidence: calls the card call with operation 0xB (the directory path) and turns result 0x18 into 0

name: OpenMemoryCardFile
evidence: card call (operation 2) with a path and flags that returns the file handle through the last argument; func_0018D368 passes 514 to create a file

name: CloseMemoryCardFile
evidence: card call with operation 3 on a handle

name: ReadMemoryCardFile
evidence: card call with operation 5 on a handle, a buffer and a size; func_0018CDD8 reads a 0x1A00 slot with it and checks the byte count

name: WriteMemoryCardFile
evidence: card call with operation 6 on a handle, data and size; func_0018D368 compares the byte count it returns with the size

name: CreateMemoryCardFile
evidence: opens the path for creation, writes version bytes from data, requires the byte count to match (else 7) and closes the file
